phase: Insurance Lead Follow-Up Domain and D1 Executor
objective: Create the canonical provider-neutral scheduling policy and narrow single-row persistence executor for insurance lead follow-up using RiverCrmRelationship.nextFollowUpAt.

identity.rule: No second follow-up identity or store is introduced.

schedule.input: absolute timestamp carrying Z or an explicit numeric UTC offset

timestamps.updatedAt: server supplied occurredAt normalized to UTC ISO
timestamps.stalePolicy: Changed follow-up state requires occurredAt to be strictly later than current relationship.updatedAt so the optimistic-concurrency token advances; no-op performs no write.

eventPolicy.reason: Existing callback-requested and appointment-set event types do not truthfully represent an internal producer-created follow-up reminder.
